clauses.reason: The sole clause transfers the functions, powers and duties of the High Commissioner, with the personnel, records, property and funds of the office, to the Secretary of the Interior. Paragraph 1 of EO 9616, signed September 14, 1945 (10 FR 11837), repeals EO 9245 by number and date and transfers the same matters back to the High Commissioner; the held Federal Register text shows no deferred effective date, so the first end is 1945-09-14 by presidential express repeal.

savings.reason: The functions, powers, duties, personnel, records, property and funds that EO 9245 moved to the Secretary of the Interior are transferred back to the High Commissioner by paragraph 1 of EO 9616; no U.S. Code or eCFR citation of EO 9245 was found by the bounded searches.
